research_question: Can a world-action model's predicted future help distinguish following the wrong goal from failing to execute the right one?
operational_scope: Compare visible object choice, motion direction and spatial relations in predicted videos with aligned executed prefixes. Predictions cannot establish physical support/contact or internal understanding by themselves.

prompt_forms.D: Direct instruction; native exact default where explicitly marked.
prompt_forms.S: Same physical goal, manipulated object appears first in the relation clause.
prompt_forms.I: Same physical goal, reference appears first using the converse relation. This changes phrasing and relation vocabulary, not an isolated token-order intervention.

extras.text: Place the mustard on the table between the two bins.
